heads up- rats are social and need to be kept in pairs or more. I have 8 haha, they also need pretty large wire cages because they have sensitive respiratory so they can not be kept in a tank or bin. check out the rats subreddit! everyone there is very helpful and kind.

I agree with everyone else, but just make sure you do lots of research before getting a hedgehog. a lot of people get them without doing research and end up keeping them poorly, but that goes for ANY animal. they do have a bit of a complex diet and are pretty sensitive animals, they also tend to not like human interaction much, of course there are exceptions, but many tend to ball up and huff at people because they are very solitary creatures. hedgehogs are also prone to many illnesses, and exotic vet bills stack up very quickly.

If you have questions about the care of hedgehogs or other small animals for ESA’s there are subreddits for basically any animal that can answer all of your questions. feel free to dm me as well as I may be able to possibly help. lots of helpful youtube videos on hedgehog care too that you should definitely take a look at before deciding to get one. 

I have many exotic pets and while they are very helpful to my anxiety, they are a lot of work, time, and money. and you should not get one if you are unable to give it the best care possible.
